property_summary: For any caller and any admissible amount/unlockTime, a single call to Collect(_am) on the correct contract cannot result in the caller receiving more than _am in total from that one Collect invocation; removing the require(!locked_) (disabling the guard) allows a reentrant fallback to cause more than _am to be sent in one Collect call.
change_summary: Remove the nonReentrant_ guard by deleting the require check so reentrancy protection is disabled (modifier still present but does not block).
